description: Pre-195 (pre-grading-ladder) game-level wall-clock timing baseline for Phase 199's D-08 before/after comparison. Derived by scripts/parse_calibration_timing_baseline.py from local, gitignored run.log files (2026-07-19/23 mtimes) joined against their sibling committed raw ledger TSVs. See `limits` below before using these numbers.

1300,0.05.role: light dip (non-monotone, most fragile point on the curve)

2300,0.5.role: deep 2300 — shared with all four rung-1800 personas post-retargeting

provenance.new_sweep_launch_note: Plan 199-04 launched the actual post-195 5-cell parity sweep (PIDs 1111151-1111155, out-dirs reports/data/sweep-199-*) under this git sha, ~2026-07-31T21:57Z, resolved via `git log --oneline -1 --before="2026-07-31T22:00:00Z"` and cross-checked against 199-04-SUMMARY.md. This baseline artifact itself was generated at current_head_sha_at_generation, a later commit in the same phase (199-05) — the new sweep's own per-game ledger rows (once plan 06 completes) carry their own git_sha, which is the true 'after' side of the comparison.

limits.local_only_fidelity: The five raw run.log files this artifact is derived from are gitignored (.gitignore lines 237-238) and were never committed — they exist only on the machine that ran the original 2026-07-19/23 sweeps. If those local files are lost, this derivation cannot be re-run, and the numbers in this JSON become the only surviving record of the pre-195 side of the timing comparison.
limits.retired_scale_exclusion: reports/data/calibration-fullgrid-run.log and reports/data/calibration-blend0-run.log were deliberately excluded: they use the retired maia900 anchor token and blend values {0, 0.5, 1} from the 2026-07-12 clamped-run incident, not the current Phase-173/180 anchor scale (blends {0, 0.05, 0.5}).
limits.locate_pass_inclusion: These baseline numbers include each cell's locate-pass games (the two-pass locate-then-bracket schedule Phase 180 used before D-02 pinned brackets), which the new post-195 sweep skips entirely per D-02. A raw ratio of these numbers against the new sweep's timing therefore overstates the grading ladder's own contribution unless the locate-pass games are accounted for separately.
limits.cell_absence: All 5 target curve cells (per 199-CONTEXT.md D-05) were found present with real game data in reports/data/sweep-{human,light,deep}/run.log — every one of the 5 (bot_elo, bot_blend) pairs D-05 selected is drawn from the same Phase-180 grid these logs already cover (see RESEARCH.md's verified per-cell bracket table, which independently shows 96 verified games for every one of the 5 cells). The phase plan (199-05-PLAN.md) anticipated one cell would be absent; that expectation did not hold once actually checked against these files, so no cell is recorded as absent here — see the plan's SUMMARY for this deviation.
limits.crash_orphan_note: reports/data/sweep-light and reports/data/sweep-deep each had 4 crash-orphaned partial-game segments (a supervised process crash mid-game, replayed at the same game_index on resume — see their supervisor.log), which the parser discarded rather than folding into any cell. See provenance.sources[].orphan_segment_count/orphan_ply_count for the exact counts per source.
limits.seed_130_note: This baseline, like the new sweep it will be compared against, is measured by the harness, which clears the Stockfish hash before every grading call — the shipped browser never does (SEED-130, open). Neither side of this timing comparison is bit-identical to shipped browser wall-clock behavior.
